name: dropit-image-processor
description: AWS Lambda function that resizes Dropit images and converts them to WebP

scripts.package:x64: npm ci --omit=dev --os=linux --cpu=x64 && zip -r image-processor.zip index.mjs package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.package:arm64: npm ci --omit=dev --os=linux --cpu=arm64 && zip -r image-processor.zip index.mjs package.json package-lock.json node_modules
